top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Inflation Worries Boost Bond Yields: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A record-breaking run in stocks hit a wall as still-elevated oil prices lifted bond yields, stoking concerns that potential inflationary pressures could trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New York’s Record Profits, Hidden Risks
top_signals.summary: Wall Street is racking up a potential record $90 billion in profits, supercharging New York’s tax revenues—but is this AI-fueled boom built to last? New York State Comptroller Thomas DiNapoli joins Bloomberg Open Interest to break down jobs, bonuses, rebates, and the risks of an AI-driven bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
